And if you are not familiar with Jocelyn Bo or Whitney White's work yet familiar. They are both absolutely fantastic. Nothing. But there's also a lot of humanity to these stories. Judge has African hair braiding takes place over a single work day in this salon. So you see all of the women that work at the salon as well as the customers and people that come in through the salon during the day. And there is so much happening in this play, and it is all brought to life brilliantly by director Whitney White. It's absolute perfection. Go see this. This is a very Limited run. It just got extended one more time until November 19th. I truly loved this, and this was just such a treat to watch in so many ways.
